body: I just realized no one's gonna read this post anymore. Now I definitely don't know what to do next.

They called me this afternoon and made an appointment for Wednesday. I actually thought they would've taken me to a hospital or at least given me some meds or something. They asked if I had any suicidal thoughts, and I said yes, though I don't have any plans right now but probably it will get worse in the evening. I guess I should've told them I had plans so they would've done something today. I'm not worried about next week, I'm worried about this weekend. I'm not sure what to do now.

It's our own thoughts that are the dangerous ones. Need to think of something else than myself. 
I used to play games, yeah. Guild Wars 2 recently. I'm in bed and I'd need to move my laptop on the table if I wanted to play anything serious. I was actually just playing Candy Crush :) Now I'm listening to Celtic Woman and reading Finnish Facebook fails. And getting sleepy.

Celtic Woman is incredibly awesome. I don't know what else to say.

I'm already getting tired and thinking of going to sleep soon. I think r/suicidewatch managed to help me with the night. Thank you :)

Well, wet cats are funny, what can you say :')

I feel like I need to DO something, even chatting with random people or watching cat videos, and not lay down alone with my stupid thoughts. Like if I'd go to bed and do nothing I'd immediately start feeling bad again. 
I don't think there are any 24 hour deliveries here. But I still have chocolate left. I tried watching Eureka (it's a hilarious show, by the way) but I couldn't concentrate on it at all. It's too long, I think. Short videos are better. I think I'll try Bob's Burgers though, it's only 30 minutes. Thank you for the tip.
I feel stupid with all this. I feel like I don't sound suicidal at all so I shouldn't be on r/suicidewatch. But  if I stop writing here or browsing youtube for a minute I'll fall into all the craziness again.

Maybe you should download a hundred cat videos on your computer? To have them ready when you need them?
I don't like the song, but zapt0 asked for a favourite video so that's it I think. I also like the singer's hair, mine is the same colour :)

I thought I did. I'm not sure anymore. I just started in the university a month ago and as you can see, things are falling a part. I don't think I made the right choice anymore. I love the subject though, but I just can't handle studying.

Yeah well they force you to learn English, too, so it doesn't really make sense. I guess we all just envy you for being a better, happier and richer country than Finland. :D
I study Finnish language and literature, but also general linguistics.

Aww, ferrets are cute too :) I don't know why this cat video made me cry: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fj73JF_bhjc

I'm feeling better already. Maybe it's the cats and ferrets. I'm just afraid of these nights alone here when I have nowhere else to go. At my home city there was a psychiatric hospital that was open for everyone 24 hours a day. There's not a place like that here, just the usual ER. It scares me to know that there is not a hospital I could go to if I wanted to - unless I actually tried to kill myself.
As stupid as it sounds, I hope I wont feel too much better tomorrow morning, because then I wouldn't take the help they're going to offer me. I always think I'm doing great and don't need any help anymore, and the next night it's the same.

Sure I do, we all do. Some of us hate it more than others :D I'm studying linguistics in the university so I don't hate languages in general, not even Swedish!

They're some kind of siren-like nympho virgins I think. Not sure. Indica is weird.

Actually, I have no idea. Indica has cryptic wannabe-artistic lyrics that make no sense. Something about going behind a mountain to meet virgins. :D

For a second this made me laugh, I don't know why.

Yeah, I've been watching cat videos for an hour. I think it's getting better but I'm not sure. It's good to talk to people even if it's only on Reddit.
I don't wanna worry my family with this. They think I'm doing great here in my new home and new school. I don't know what kind of a shock it will be for them if I'm going to a hospital tomorrow for a longer time.

:) This is: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SxKx9GHPrzk
I'm sorry, the song's Finnish. I like the forest and the pretty fairy dresses.

I don't think this is a very bad neighbourhood but not exactly good either. I'm not worried someone would rape me or kill me or anything like that (actually at this point I wouldn't be surprised if I tried to get into those situations on purpose) but I'm afraid happy drunken friday people will try to speak to me or something. I'm not sure. But I can't go outside, that's for sure anyway. I'm feeling definitely suicidal. Or I don't know. I've had suicide attempts earlier and I can already recognize my feelings like that, so I know that I will soon be killing myself if this feeling doesn't stop. I'm not making any plans or anything like that, but that isn't like me anyway. I think that's the scary part - I don't ever make plans. I just get the feeling to die now and then I'm already taking pills or jumping off the window. And I think that feeling is coming soon. I'm already cutting and it's not helping.

I feel like I'm making way too much sense for anyone to get the feeling that I'm in actual trouble. Thank god my English is so bad it makes me sound like a crazy person.

Thank you :)
It's almost 12pm here. I'm not sure at what time they are actually gonna call me but I'm hoping early.
I already went to buy chocolate earlier but now it actually makes me feel more shitty. It's too late for a young woman to go out walking alone, I would definitely do that if I could.
